name: genpark-personal-agent-biometric-circadian-energy-scheduler-skill
description: Proactive Personal Agent Biometric & Circadian Energy Scheduler. Models the Borbely Two-Process sleep/alertness dynamics (homeostatic sleep pressure Process S + circadian rhythm Process C) from wearable telemetry (HRV, sleep duration, wake hour), aligns high-cognitive deep work to peak alertness windows, and inserts ultradian recovery breaks.

tools.name: schedule_by_circadian_energy
tools.description: Compute hourly cognitive alertness curve from sleep/HRV telemetry and assign tasks to optimal circadian energy slots.

tasks.description: Tasks with title, cognitive_load (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW), duration_hours.
